description.text: An enhanced expansion pack released on 3 May 2018 with many cards whose effects remake cards that were strong in earlier years of the game. Scizor-GX, Articuno-GX, Salamence-GX, Banette-GX, Electrode-GX, which can do up to 300 damage, and Mr. Mime-GX lead it. Its Trainers and Special Energy are all reprints of past cards recreating the design of their first printing. Packs held five cards, and each box of 30 held one card of Super Rare or higher. The cards are numbered to 66, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-GX and Supporters, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Life Herb, PokéNav and Rainbow Energy. In English many of its cards came out in Celestial Storm in August 2018.
